mkdir -p /tmp/fu-scripts && cat > /tmp/fu-scripts/build.py <<'EOF'
import csv, sys
from datetime import datetime
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from attendance import load, as_utc
rows = load()
best = {}
for r in rows:
    k = (r["badge"], r["session"])
    t = datetime.fromisoformat(r["observed_at"])
    if k in best and best[k][0] == t and best[k][1]["status"] != r["status"] or (k in best and best[k][0]==t and best[k][1]["started_at"]!=r["started_at"]):
        raise SystemExit(f"tie on observed_at for {k}")
    if k not in best or t > best[k][0]:
        best[k] = (t, r)
out = [(k[0], k[1], as_utc(r["started_at"])) for k, (t, r) in sorted(best.items()) if r["status"] != "cancelled"]
import os; os.makedirs("build", exist_ok=True)
with open("build/normalized.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n"); w.writerow(["badge","session","start_utc"]); w.writerows(out)
print(len(out), "rows")
EOF
